topic.label: Claude Code Plugins and Marketplaces
topic.desc: Using, creating, testing and distributing Claude Code plugins and mods, running a marketplace and managing plugins for an organization.

skills: Understand what a Claude Code plugin is, when you need one instead of a standalone skill or MCP server, and which page to read to install or create one. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/overview
Install Claude Code plugins from a marketplace on any surface you use, choose an install scope, and update or remove them later. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/install

Anthropic's official and community plugin marketplaces for Claude Code: their names, repositories, how you add each, and where to browse their plugins. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/anthropic-marketplaces

Install a language server plugin so Claude sees type errors after edits and navigates code by symbol, and answer the LSP plugin recommendation dialog. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/code-intelligence
Decide whether to trust a plugin before you install it, from what a plugin can do on your machine to how to review one and remove it. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/security
Build your first Claude Code plugin from an empty directory, test it without a marketplace, and convert an existing .claude/ setup. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/create
Add skills, hooks, MCP servers, and every other component type to a Claude Code plugin, with an example that validates for each. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/components
Declare the plugins your plugin depends on, with version ranges such as ^1.2, and see how Claude Code installs, resolves, and prunes them. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/dependencies

Write eval cases for your Claude Code plugin, run them with claude plugin eval, grade the results, compare against a no-plugin baseline, and gate CI on the score. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-evals
Publish a Claude Code plugin through your own marketplace or Anthropic's directory, with a pre-release checklist and how users get updates. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/publish

Measure a Claude Code plugin's token cost, find out whether people still use it, and pick the telemetry events for organization-wide plugin questions. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/measure
Recommend your plugin from your CLI
Prompt Claude Code users to install your official-marketplace plugin by emitting a claude-code-hint tag from your CLI or SDK. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/cli-hints

Add panes, commands, and tool call rules to Claude Code with a mod. See what a mod can do, how to make or install one, and where mods run. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview

Have Claude write a Claude Code mod from a description, or write one yourself that counts tool calls and adds a command. Learn the reload and validate loop. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/create

Complete reference for Claude Code mods: hooks module layout, events, mods API methods, render sites, elements by surface, limits, and settings. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference
Draw in the interface with a mod

Draw panes, a band above the prompt, buttons, and text fields from a Claude Code mod, handle presses and input, and keep state between redraws and sessions. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/interface

See the interface elements a Claude Code mod can draw, such as text, buttons, fields, Markdown, code, and diffs, with sample code and terminal screenshots. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/gallery
React to events with a mod

Handle Claude Code events from a mod: observe, rewrite, or answer tool calls, prompts, and turns, filter which events a hook handles, and plan for other mods. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/events

Call the mods API from a Claude Code mod to add commands and tools, call a model, run work on a timer, message other sessions, and reach files and the network. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/api

Write automated tests for a Claude Code mod that fire events, stub Claude Code's answers, and press buttons, with no session, sign-in, or network. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/test

Find out why a Claude Code mod does nothing: match the symptom or message to its cause, look up refusal messages, and read the debug log. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/troubleshoot
Build a plugin marketplace from a marketplace.json file and test it locally before you host it. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/create-marketplace

Publish a plugin marketplace where users can reach it, grant access to a private one, and release updates and renames without breaking installs. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/host-marketplace

Add a relevance block to marketplace plugin entries so Claude Code suggests them when a user's work matches, and allowlist the marketplace in managed settings. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/relevance
Manage Claude Code plugins for your organization
Control which plugins Claude Code installs and allows across your organization through managed settings. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/org

Control Claude Code mods with managed settings: stop user-installed mods, allow only your own, review what a mod can do, and enforce policy with your own mod. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/admin

Fix plugin errors in Claude Code. Find the exact message you saw, grouped by stage from where /plugin runs through install and org policy. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/troubleshooting
Trace where Claude Code loads each plugin from, which settings file decides whether it loads, and why an update changed nothing. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/loading

Complete reference for plugin.json: every field with its type and default, accepted path forms, and the userConfig and environment variable schemas. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference

Complete reference for marketplace.json fields, plugin entries, and the plugin and marketplace source objects, with where each is valid. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/marketplace-reference

Reference for the claude plugin shell commands, /plugin and /reload-plugins in a session, and the flags that load a plugin for one session. Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/cli-reference
